name: JellyGlance overview
description: Sessions, downloads, alerts, storage, invites, and upcoming releases from JellyGlance.

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">JellyGlance</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.storage} · {data.sessionsToday} today · {data.users} users</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.digestOk ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.digestOk ? "Clear" : String(data.digest) + " alerts"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Grid gutter="xs">
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="violet">Sessions</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.sessionsRecent}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="blue">Downloads</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.downloads}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="red">Alerts</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.digest}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="teal">Stalled</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.stalled}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="orange">Invites</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.invites}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={4}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="indigo">Upcoming</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.calendarUpcoming}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
  </Grid>
</Stack>
